nl: Write the rows of sales.csv whose region is east to out/east.csv, with the header line first and the rows in their original order.
oracle_program: read "sales.csv" |> filter region == "east" |> write "out/east.csv" format: csv parents: true
reference_pwsh:
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force out | Out-Null
$rows = Import-Csv sales.csv | Where-Object region -eq 'east'
$rows | ConvertTo-Csv -NoTypeInformation -UseQuotes Never | Set-Content out/east.csv
